Fried Rice with Sauce

A quick weeknight fried rice, built to check that the section headings survive text extraction.

Advertisement: buy our cookware. Limited time offer, click here to save.

Sauce

  • 2 tbsp soy sauce
  • 1 tbsp sesame oil

Fried rice

  • 2 cups cooked rice
  • 2 eggs
  • 1 cup peas
  1. Whisk the sauce ingredients together.
  2. Fry the rice with the eggs and peas.
